Removing

- Fit a new gasket to the cylinder head.

- Fit the cylinder head extension complete with camshafts and camshaft timing tools.

When fitting the cylinder head extension, take particular care to ensure that the tappet rockers do not move while fitting the cylinder head extension to the cylinder head.

- Tighten the bolts securing the cylinder head extension to the cylinder head to torque.
